content.tagline: Korean skincare: even tone, hydration, sun care
content.descriptor: Ooznary — a Korean skincare brand by DOTS CORPORATION
about: Ooznary is a skincare brand of the Korean company DOTS CORPORATION. The brand’s principle: healthy skin starts with skincare, not makeup. The name combines the English words “ooze” and “ordinary”.
The range is organised into lines: Vita3 for an even skin tone, Jet Blue for hydration, the Rest and The Sun sunscreen, the two-phase Micro Oil Blender 37 serums, and sheet masks.

The brand’s products are sold online in the USA, including Amazon and TikTok Shop, in Japan, in Vietnam, online in China and through live commerce in Singapore. Its expansion priority is Türkiye and other new markets.
facts: Toners, serums, creams, sun care, masks

lines.name: Vita3
lines.note: Line for an even tone: ACE Aurora toner, Aurora Mist, Vita3 Serum and the overnight BBC Pudding Cream. Built on vitamin complexes.

lines.name: Jet Blue
lines.note: Hydrating line: toner, serum and cream. Formulas include panthenol, amino acids, hyaluronic acid and ceramides.

lines.name: Rest and The Sun
lines.note: Sunscreen with a light lotion texture and white ginger lily extract.

lines.name: Micro Oil Blender 37
lines.note: Two-phase serums in three versions: azelaic acid, centella with PDRN, and retinol.

lines.name: Sheet masks
lines.note: Four masks based on the core products: Vita 3, Azelaic Cica, Centella PDRN and Retinol AHA.

tech.name: Oil and water at 3:7
tech.note: In the Micro Oil Blender 37 serums the oil and water phases are combined at a 3:7 ratio; the bottle is shaken before use.

formats: Finished products under the Ooznary brand
